headline: Senate passes Veterans COLA boost while House marches through small-business bills on legislative priority day!

senate.lastSessionSummary: The Senate passed the Veterans' Compensation Cost-of-Living Adjustment Act (H.R. 8552), boosting disability compensation for veterans effective December 1, 2026. Three resolutions honoring veterans and recognizing National Warrior Call Day and Veterans Small Business Week also passed unanimously.

house.lastSessionSummary: The House passed seven bills focused on small-business support, including cybersecurity initiatives, SBA modernization, and reshoring manufacturing efforts. H.R. 1013 (403(b) retirement plan reforms) passed 295-128, and H.R. 9237 (veterans benefits improvements) passed by voice vote.
